# discord_channels (Data Source)

Lists the channels of a server, optionally only those of one type or in one category, ordered by position and then ID. Threads are not included; use `discord_threads`. Starting November 16, 2026, Discord omits channels the bot cannot view: the bot needs the View Channel permission on a channel, or to be connected to it if it is a voice channel, and a category is listed when any of its channels is.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Let moderators read and send messages in every text channel of a category.
data "discord_channels" "staff" {
  server_id   = var.server_id
  type        = "text"
  category_id = var.staff_category_id
}

resource "discord_channel_permission" "moderators" {
  for_each = toset([for c in data.discord_channels.staff.channels : c.id])

  channel_id   = each.value
  type         = "role"
  overwrite_id = var.moderator_role_id
  allow        = provider::discord::permissions(["VIEW_CHANNEL", "SEND_MESSAGES"])
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `server_id` (String) ID of the server (guild).

### Optional

- `category_id` (String) Only list channels in this category.
- `type` (String) Only list channels of this type: `text`, `voice`, `category`, `announcement`, `stage`, `forum` or `media`.

### Read-Only

- `channels` (Attributes List) The channels. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--channels))

<a id="nestedatt--channels"></a>
### Nested Schema for `channels`

Read-Only:

- `category_id` (String) Parent category ID.
- `id` (String) Channel ID.
- `name` (String) Channel name.
- `nsfw` (Boolean) Whether the channel is age-restricted.
- `position` (Number) Sort position.
- `topic` (String) Channel topic.
- `type` (String) Channel type, or `unknown_<n>` for a type the provider does not manage.
